description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests and setup routines for verifying the behavior of 'git log' with Bloom filters and commit-graph features in a Git repository. It includes test setup, expectations, and validations for correct handling of Bloom filters, commit-graph layers, and corrupted data, primarily used for automated testing of Git's commit graph features.

methods.name: graph_read_expect
methods.description: A helper function that reads the commit-graph structure and verifies that it contains expected chunks and options, particularly Bloom filter options, by comparing the actual output against expected output.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares a test repository by initializing it, making commits, and generating commit graphs with and without Bloom filters, to set up various test scenarios.

methods.name: test_bloom_filters_used
methods.description: Checks if Bloom filters are used in the commit graph during log operations for specific path expressions and options.

methods.name: test_bloom_filters_not_used
methods.description: Verifies that Bloom filters are not used during certain log operations, ensuring correct fallback behaviors.

methods.name: get_first_changed_path_filter
methods.description: Reads the first Bloom filter for changed paths from the commit graph metadata for inspection.

methods.name: check_corrupt_graph
methods.description: Simulates corruption in the commit-graph file and tests if Git correctly handles corrupt data and produces expected warnings.
